author: Helenilson GameDev
title: Pixel artist needed for Geometry Survivors
content:
I’m looking for a pixel artist to help with my game, Geometry Survivors! I need art for the game, upgrade cards, and some UI elements.

Interested? Send me a DM with your portfolio and rates. Feel free to tag an artist who might be a good fit! #indiedev #pixelart
Contact: DM @Lannpiao
